scope: Manually traced shared-intent groups; not a claim of complete canonical operation migration

reviewedIntents.store: client.settings.model (Guild.language), shared SyncMap exclusive queue and cache patch
reviewedIntents.actor: guild member authenticated by Gateway or OAuth; actor ID from interaction/session

permissions.discord: Administrator plus fresh member/channel/bot access at save
permissions.web: existing owner/Administrator/ManageGuild gate plus fresh OAuth guild permissions and CSRF

reviewedIntents.permissionDifference: Preserve existing narrower Discord setup access; no new privilege grants
reviewedIntents.confirmation: explicit setup Save, slash invocation or separate web Guardar idioma
reviewedIntents.result: success only after awaited atomic conditional persistence; failure/conflict never reports success
reviewedIntents.cooldown: existing Discord dispatch cooldown; web uses existing dashboard middleware
reviewedIntents.idempotency: CAS rejects stale retry; unchanged value with matching revision is a no-op; no durable cross-transport operation receipt
effects: publish committed language to cache when no newer legacy cache write exists
reviewedIntents.i18n: setup.language.* in es/en; other loaded legacy languages use existing Spanish UI fallback
reviewedIntents.material: native Discord embed and existing dashboard settings card
reviewedIntents.recovery: read current persisted revision after uncertain result; no blind retry
reviewedIntents.remaining: Authenticated real Discord/OAuth walkthrough; durable cross-transport receipt remains T12/T13

reviewedIntents.finding: All write the same field independently. Discord rejects length >5; web truncates to5, whitespace validation differs. Cache-first background writes can acknowledge before persistence.

reviewedIntents.service: handlers/music/likes.js#setLiked (toggleLike delegates to setLiked); music database.setLikedSong delegates to the same owner
reviewedIntents.store: LikedSongsSchema, personal userId and stable recording key
reviewedIntents.finding: Discord hearts toggle current recording; web can set an explicit desired state for library removal. These input differences preserve the same personal ownership.

reviewedIntents.service: handlers/music/prefix-compat.js delegates supported prefix actions to slash adapters; web calls handlers/music/database.js
reviewedIntents.finding: Same persisted collection, separate mutation logic and validation; prefix does not expose add and defaults share differently. Schema sharing does not establish one operation owner or concurrent-edit safety.

Prefix membership setup and slash use published configuration port; web editor stages drafts before publication. Draft versus direct published write is an explicit existing flow difference, not duplicate published ownership. Extended cards/DM/leave remain separate legacy settings.

reviewedIntents.store: client.settings Guild logs, shared setup-settings CAS
reviewedIntents.finding: Same service checks fresh ManageGuild membership and channel visibility; prefix metadata still additionally requires Administrator. Retained compatibility restriction is recorded, not declared the desired final policy.
Discord and web share help projections; web context requires dashboard guild access. Read projections do not execute commands or accept all catalog behavior.

Different case histories, actor policies and automatic warning consequences. Prefix checks configured admin/cmd roles and triggers threshold actions; slash requires KickMembers and creates a separate Mongo case. No common sanction/case authority.
reviewedIntents.migrationRequirement: Reconcile existing records and policy explicitly before replacing either path; do not silently discard warning history or duplicate sanctions.

reviewedIntents.finding: Independent check/debit/credit operations; slash validates a safe integer and self-payment, prefix accepts Number. Shared cache does not make two-account transfer atomic or durable.

limits: Source tracing establishes current authorities, not end-to-end acceptance
Only language write behavior was executed against synthetic state in this increment
No moderation actions, Discord messages, real database writes or voice joins used for this review
